x: Wooderson to lead them and men like Poole, Whittingham, Wiard, Parkes and Page, they present a very formidable opposition, and if our boys can pull it off, then they will have well deserved our congratulations.
Our Canadian friend Page scored a double by winning the 100 and 220 yds. In the former he was chased home by the Fire Services champion Rowe and in the 220 our own Dumbrill was 2nd and Rowe 3rd.
